obernants.domain: Finite byte strings s and query q; count observation is u128; allocations must succeed.
obernants.operator: Universe is (s,q,b,count). Exclude b disagreeing with interval occurrence (empty occurs), and counts unequal to the cardinality of nonempty interval values. State numbering and occurrence multiplicities are not observable.
obernants.assumptions: Stable Eq semantics where relevant; successful allocation; ordinary Rust execution.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Exact mathematical target; finite evidence does not establish a universal proof.

obernants.operator: For a complete membership language L, compatible texts are exactly s with substring-set including empty equal to L. A realizable finite L has a unique longest word s, recovering the text. Count alone admits all texts with that count: ab and ba both give 3; a count does not recover symbols.
